title: Specification (requirements with EARS-formatted functional requirements)
description: EARS-formatted functional requirements in English or Japanese, ISO/IEC 25010 non-functional requirements, and Given-When-Then acceptance criteria. English EARS patterns are ubiquitous, event-driven, state-driven, unwanted-behavior and optional-feature requirements. The body uses Markdoc {% req id="FR-XXX" %} / {% acceptance id="AC-XXX" %} tags whose IDs must match frontmatter.

plan.description: Primary plan id implementing this spec. Use links.related_plans for multiple plans.

statement.pattern: ^((The system (shall|SHALL|MUST|MUST NOT) |When .+, the system (shall|SHALL|MUST|MUST NOT) |While .+, the system (shall|SHALL|MUST|MUST NOT) |If .+, then the system (shall|SHALL|MUST|MUST NOT) |Where .+, the system (shall|SHALL|MUST|MUST NOT) )|(システムは|もし.+(なら|であれば|場合)、システムは|.+(とき|時|間|場合|後|ごとに|時に)、システムは)).+$
statement.description: EARS format. English patterns: 'The system (shall|SHALL|MUST|MUST NOT) ...' (ubiquitous), 'When <trigger>, the system ...' (event-driven), 'While <state>, the system ...' (state-driven), 'If <condition>, then the system ...' (unwanted), and 'Where <feature>, the system ...' (optional). RFC 2119 terms (SHALL/MUST/MUST NOT) were added in v1 (adr-20260709-rfc2119-staged-adoption); SHOULD/MAY/SHALL NOT/WHERE are reserved for v2. Japanese EARS forms are also recognized by the validation pattern.

criteria.description: Measurable criterion. Pattern is not enforced; agent should prefer numeric / observable thresholds.

entities.description: [x-tentative] spec-detail (2026-07-09): Optional Data Model section. Frontmatter signal: pipeline G1 triggers on three or more entity nouns. Each entry has an entity and invariants / normalization_rules. Source of truth: artifacts/architecture-contract/semantics.md §14. Deprecation criterion: remove if fewer than two specs outside spec-detail use this by 2027-01-09 (six months later).

fields.description: For example, 'id: uuid (immutable)' — put the type and constraint on one line.

state_machine.description: [x-tentative] spec-detail (2026-07-09): Optional State Machine section. Frontmatter signal: trigger with at least one state_driven FR and two unwanted FRs. The <state> in each state_driven FR statement references states[].id; the docs lint Markdoc validator checks consistency (FR-007 / NFR-003). Source of truth: artifacts/architecture-contract/semantics.md §15. Deprecation criterion: remove if fewer than two specs outside spec-detail use this by 2027-01-09.

id.description: Target referenced by <state> in a state_driven FR statement.

idempotency.description: For example, 'idempotent (duplicate trigger is a no-op)'.

failure_modes.description: [x-tentative] spec-detail (2026-07-09): Optional Failure Modes section. Frontmatter signal: trigger when source_paths are present or at least one NFR has reliability quality. In recovery, reference the three categories in error-design-triage §13: semantic redefinition, fail_fast and recovery. Source of truth: artifacts/architecture-contract/semantics.md §16 (three-party source-of-truth table). Deprecation criterion: remove if fewer than two specs outside spec-detail use this by 2027-01-09.

recovery.description: Corresponds to error-design-triage §13 categories: retry/degrade = recovery, fail_fast = internal contract violation, escalate = external notification/manual action.

related_fr.description: Related unwanted FR (source of truth: an unwanted FR is a state that must not occur; Failure Modes are failure class × recovery).

non_goals.description: [x-tentative] spec-detail (2026-07-09): Optional Non-Goals section. Always opt-in (do not ask in G1). Two levels: MUST NOT (never) and SHOULD NOT (normally). Source of truth: artifacts/architecture-contract/semantics.md §20, consistent with the RFC 2119 mapping in §17. Deprecation criterion: remove if fewer than two specs outside spec-detail use this by 2027-01-09.

worked_examples.description: [x-tentative] spec-detail (2026-07-09): Optional Worked Example section. Include two or three I/O examples per primary FR (maximum five). Do not write a counterexample for a feature with UX (ux.md is the source of truth); allow one only for a backend feature without UX (FR-009). Source of truth: artifacts/architecture-contract/semantics.md §19. Deprecation criterion: remove if fewer than two specs outside spec-detail use this by 2027-01-09.

counterexample.description: Allow one only for a backend feature without UX. Omit for features with UX; ux.md is the source of truth for counterexamples.
